args.sql:
CREATE VIEW vw_observation_quality AS
SELECT 
    o.observstation AS observatory_station,
    t.telescregistry AS telescope,
    s.signalregistry AS signal,
    sp.falseposprob AS false_positive_probability,
    sp.sigunique AS signal_uniqueness,
    sp.simindex AS similarity_index,
    sp.corrscore AS correlation_score,
    sp.anomscore AS anomaly_score,
    sp.techsigprob AS technosignature_probability,
    sp.biosigprob AS biosignature_probability,
    sp.natsrcprob AS natural_source_probability,
    sp.artsrcprob AS artificial_source_probability
FROM 
    observatories o
JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
JOIN signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref;
